lines: Even a little bit of dirt won't bother me.
I'll eat it all without leaving anything behind.
Wow darling, who are you?
Grasping the truth tightly.
If you doubt me,
I'll cut my own throat for you.
Wow darling, I'm a no‑talin.
I'll give you something precious, wow‑wow.
Even standing in a maddening city,
Even my emotions feel real,
Though I seem about to lose them,
In this discordant life,
I sometimes become emotionally unstable, right?
But darlin, we can trouble together,
I devote my whole life to you.
The weakness that makes it impossible to live with a heart just as it is,
I spend my days blaming someone else.
Unknowingly I built it,
Within the cage of my own self,
If I'm still struggling,
I'm the same way too.
No matter how much comrades understand each other,
Lonely nights will still come.
Wow darling, this lingering resentment,
It probably will never disappear, oh‑wow.
I've used many things as stepping stones,
But the thing I must not lose,
Finally feels like I've found it.
Your gestures are so ridiculous,
Yet they make me feel gentle.
Wow darling, a fairy‑tale.
Every time we meet, tell me again.
Love is neither stealing nor giving,
It simply appears when you notice it.
Singing while the city wind blows,
Just discard that strange pride.
That's where it all begins.
Despair, disappointment, down.
What are you brooding over?
Love, freedom, hope, dreams, courage.
Look at your feet; they're probably rolling around.
Falling into a love left to chance,
Even if you sometimes hurt someone,
This isn’t a time that wounds the heart each time.
If you yearn for someone, you become a fool.
It pierces my own chest.
But,
Because I wish to live with a heart just as it is,
People keep getting hurt again.
Unknowingly I built it,
Within the cage of my own self,
If you're struggling, anyone is the same,
I'm the same way too.
Love is a formless thing called affection.
Conveying it is always difficult.
So darlin, this “Nameless Poem”,
I’ll keep offering it to you forever.
